page.overview:
Who is Dork the Ox?

Dork the Ox was an ox purchased by Vex'ahlia that Vox Machina attempted to place into their bag of holding during their pre-stream home game. When they later retrieved Dork, they learned that living creatures do not survive within the confines of the bag of holding.

Keyleth once used Speak with Animals to converse with Dork, although apparently the conversation didn't go well.
